The blast occurred at a site storing explosives for mining operations, according to **rescue workers** and independent media reports. The **Ta’ang National Liberation Army (TNLA)**, an ethnic armed group that controls the area, is under investigation for the cause of the explosion.  The incident highlights ongoing tensions in Myanmar following the military coup in 2021.

recent_articles.title: Viral post claims Indian woman caught shoplifting in Japan tried to bribe shopkeeper, police: 'They respect India a lot...' - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A woman from an **Indian** tour group in Japan was allegedly caught shoplifting at a souvenir shop and offered bribes to both the shopkeeper and police officers. The **shopkeeper**, who expressed disappointment over the offer, called the police, and the tour manager accompanied the woman to the station where she again attempted to bribe officials.  The Japanese police warned her about the severity of shoplifting laws in Japan, but ultimately let her go with a severe warning due to her Indian nationality.

recent_articles.title: 'Cancel it', Trump says after artists drop out of US Freedom 250 festival
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** canceled the US Freedom 250 festival after several artists dropped out, citing its association with the White House. **Trump** called the event "overpriced" and "boring", and announced he is considering replacing it with a "Make America Great Again rally".  The festival, launched by the Trump administration, was intended to celebrate the country's 250th birthday but has faced criticism from artists who claim they were not informed of its political nature. The **White House** is partnering with Freedom 250 on the event as part of a series of events commemorating the anniversary.

recent_articles.title: ‘Right of sex workers can exist without a right to sex work: SC asks Government to make law exempting trafficked sex workers from criminal charges | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** has issued a detailed plan to protect the rights of victims of commercial sexual exploitation (CSE) while acknowledging that there is no one-size-fits-all approach. The court emphasized that trafficked victims should not be prosecuted for prostitution and called upon the government to amend the Immoral Trafficking Prevention Act (ITPA) to exempt them from prosecution.  The plan also outlines procedures for police raids to rescue victims, ensuring their dignity and safety while recognizing the complex nature of CSE and the need for a comprehensive legal framework addressing all forms of exploitation.

recent_articles.title: Inside the night Paris erupted: Vandalism, looting, violent clashes after PSG wins - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **PSG**’s Champions League victory over **Arsenal** triggered celebrations in Paris that turned violent. Thousands of fans took to the streets, setting vehicles ablaze and vandalizing property, leading to clashes with police and injuries on both sides.  Authorities reported over 780 arrests across France, with more than 500 in Paris alone. Interior Minister **Laurent Nunez** condemned the unrest as “absolutely unacceptable” while **Marine Le Pen**, leader of the far-right party, criticized the violence and questioned why football celebrations repeatedly descend into disorder. Despite the chaos, PSG's parade is scheduled to continue on Sunday with thousands of supporters expected to attend.

recent_articles.title: Food Regulator Seeks Explanation From Blinkit On Bad Quality Curd Complaint
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)** has requested an explanation from **Blinkit**, a quick commerce firm, following a complaint from a person who allegedly fell ill after consuming curd purchased on the platform. The complainant developed stomach ache and diarrhea shortly after consumption and sought medical help.  **FSSAI** has also asked for a comprehensive Action Taken Report (ATR) from **Blinkit**. This follows several other complaints regarding unhygienic or spoiled food sold through **Blinkit's** platform.
